label: Initial network CAPEX
rationale: Network build at Year 0; existing spectrum rights assumed

label: Investment horizon
rationale: Five-year cash recovery test; no automatic terminal value

label: Year 1 average active subscribers
rationale: Annual average rather than year-end subscribers

label: Monthly ARPU
rationale: Held flat; not a Bell forecast

label: Base net subscriber growth
rationale: Growth in annual average subscribers; already net of churn

label: Year 1 network operating costs
rationale: Excludes separately modeled acquisition and capitalized equipment

label: Network operating cost growth
rationale: Nominal growth already includes inflation

label: Discount rate
rationale: Nominal unlevered required return; not estimated company WACC

label: Bear net subscriber growth
rationale: Other assumptions held constant to isolate adoption

label: Bull net subscriber growth
rationale: Other assumptions held constant to isolate adoption

label: Model mode
rationale: Default expanded model; simple mode reproduces initial teaching model

label: Selected scenario
rationale: One live forecast driven by this selector

label: Incremental share of gross revenue
rationale: 15 percent of gross revenue treated as transferred existing revenue

label: Illustrative cash tax rate
rationale: Generic assumption; not a statutory rate or tax advice

label: Depreciation life
rationale: Straight line; book depreciation used as a simplified tax proxy

label: Year 1 maintenance CAPEX / initial CAPEX
rationale: Capital replacements distinct from expensed maintenance

label: Working capital / incremental revenue
rationale: No release at Year 5 because the network continues operating

label: Annual subscriber cancellation intensity
rationale: Used only to estimate replacement acquisition costs; not subtracted from net growth

label: Cost per gross subscriber acquisition
rationale: Includes initial opening subscribers at Year 0 and subsequent gross additions

label: Year 5 net residual cash proceeds
rationale: Zero default; any override must be cash net of disposal taxes and fees

label: Illustrative serviceable subscriber lines
rationale: Fictional regional cluster; not measured population or unique customers

label: Illustrative end-year subscriber capacity
rationale: Commercial planning proxy; not an RF engineering capacity calculation
